Measured 2026-07-26 on Claude Code 2.1.220: a hook registered in
~/.claude/settings.local.json never fires. Controlled A/B — same hook, same
absolute command, only the file differed — the settings.json registration
fired on every Agent dispatch and the settings.local.json one fired zero
times. Path style was ruled out separately: an absolute command in
settings.local.json also never fired, so the tilde is not the cause. At USER
scope Claude Code reads settings.json; settings.local.json is a PROJECT-scope
file (.claude/settings.local.json), and a copy at ~/.claude/ is inert.
Everything still registered in configs/claude/settings.local.json inherits
that defect and is believed inert on a deployed machine. Moving those is a
separate decision (they fire on every Write/Edit and would change behaviour
the moment they activate), so this file carries only the hook whose whole
The `~` in the command below is expanded by merge_claude_runtime_hooks at
deploy time; Claude Code is given an absolute path.
